decisions.statement: The app and the extension compile this one file rather than a copy each.
A tier is carried as the word the server sent.
Nothing here says what color a word is drawn in.
The groups are carried apart, since the lock screen keeps them apart.
The instant a reading was taken is carried as text.
ActivityKit decodes a pushed reading with a decoder no code here reaches.

definition: what the stoplights live activity carries between the app and the extension
